description: Run 1 or 2 pods of a module (freeze_module stops it). One operation runs on a module at a time, and none beside an operation on its project: the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: scale_module
title: Scale Module
